newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby League-Barnett ruled out of third league test.
newsitem.headline: Rugby League-Barnett ruled out of third league test.

text.p: CHRISTCHURCH, Oct 30 - Winger Richard Barnett has been ruled out of the New Zealand rugby league team for Friday night's third and final test against Great Britain at Lancaster Park, NZPA reported on Wednesday.
Barnett strained medial ligaments and inflamed tendons when he twisted a knee during the second test in Palmerston North last Friday.
The injury had been improving over the past few days but physio Peter Boyle ruled out the Cronulla winger after putting him through a fitness test in Christchurch this morning.
Barnett has been replaced in the run-on test side by Auckland Warrior Marc Ellis, with Anthony Swann coming into the reserves.
Swann has been with the Kiwis all week after being called up as a precaution following Barnett's injury.
